summary: Correct “word” to “world” in the translation of briṯo.
rationale: The Turoyo subject is briṯo, “world”, not “word”. Local glossary examples independently translate briṯo as “die Welt” or “the world”, including bhr.III u=yawmo ko-mabhər briṯo and the ʔxl idiom lo+koxal ʕal briṯo. This is an omitted l changing the meaning.
